title: It’s Morphin’ Time! Combating Linguistic Discrimination with Inflectional Perturbations

bias_targets.methodology: Generating adversarial examples by perturbing the inflectional morphology of words (such as nouns, verbs, and adjectives) to simulate non-standard English dialects and second-language speaker errors, and measuring the resulting performance degradation (e.g., F1 score for Question Answering, BLEU score for Machine Translation) of NLP models like BERT and Transformer.
